Severe Weather Warning for Snowy Mountains
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with peak gusts of 100 km/h are forecast from Monday morning and continue through the afternoon. For alpine areas above 1900 metres, winds may average 80 to 90 km/h with peak gusts of 110 km/h. Winds are expected to ease during Monday evening. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top, Perisher Valley and Charlotte Pass.

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for North East, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: Strong to DAMAGING WINDS averaging 55 to 65 km/h with gusts up to 100 km/h are forecast across parts of eastern Victoria during Monday. Some of these gusts may be associated with thunderstorms. Winds are expected to ease below warning thresholds by late Monday afternoon. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek and Mt Hotham. 94 km/h gust recorded at Mt Buller at 5:09 am 91 km/h gust recorded at Mt Hotham at 4:12 am
